title: breakout_2 phone: auto re-login with no human (no latch, background login check, silent-logout alarm)
note: Operator 2026-10-10: login cannot depend on manual input. PR #17365 (draft, hold, manager merges). 2026-10-10 09:35Z manager: merged 9709fbf3, APK artifact 11665937340 sent to operator. Pending: operator installs; observe login_started -> login_ok and fresh account_status on breakout_2. 2026-10-10 12:40Z OPERATOR DESIGN ASPIRATION (verbatim): 'it would be more stable if it could do it in the background ... then we wouldn't have to worry about it being able to be in the foreground, like, if I'm using the phone at the time for something else ... to the extent that it can run as backgrounded as possible and still function, that is a design aspiration, obviously within what's feasible, but the more automated and backgrounded it could be, the better.' Implication for PHONE-AUTOLOGIN-2 and later builds: prefer running the WebView work (page read, re-login, account panel read, and where feasible ticket fill/submit) without bringing the activity forward, e.g. a foreground service hosting a WebView that is never paused, over bring-to-front wakes; bring-to-front is the fallback, not the design. 2026-10-10 12:42Z MEASURED + operator observation: attempts at 12:30:35 and 12:40:45 each failed 6 s after start with 'no single number on the waiting page'. Code (MainActivity.kt relogin): after the email submit it waits a FIXED 6 s, reads __ex.loginNumber() ONCE and fails if it is not a single 1-3 digit number; the 3-minute inbox poll (18 x 10 s) is never reached. Operator (watching the phone): 'it's way not waiting long enough to see the email. That can take at least up to a minute. It needs to wait longer to see the email and see if it comes up with one of the numbers that is the correct one.' Fix (PHONE-AUTOLOGIN-2): poll the page for the number for >= 90 s, and confirm what the current Breakout flow shows (one number to match vs several numbers to choose from, with the email naming the correct one).

observation.how_to_check: curl -s 'https://ict-bot.duckdns.org/api/bot/prop/status?account_id=breakout_2' | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d['status_age_hours'],[e['kind'] for e in d.get('phone_events') or []][-10:],(d['phone_heartbeat'] or {}).get('state',{}).get('last'))"
observation.what: breakout_2 phone_events shows login_started -> logged-in (login_ok or a logged_in heartbeat) and a fresh account_status after the new APK (phone-executor-apk.yml artifact phone-executor-1b-apk) is installed
